_comment: Round-250 bilingual fixtures for Messaging. Used by messaging_describe_challenge.sh + challenges/runner/main.go to verify UTF-8 / non-ASCII payloads round-trip losslessly through every broker Publish/Subscribe path AND survive JSON Marshal/Unmarshal on the Message struct. CONST-046 alignment (no hardcoded English-only assumption).

inputs.value: Hello, world! Messages move across topics.
Zdravo, svete! Poruke putuju kroz teme.
Здраво, свете! Поруке путују кроз теме.
こんにちは、世界！メッセージはトピック間を移動します。
مرحبا بالعالم! الرسائل تنتقل عبر المواضيع.

expected_invariants.byte_preservation: Input value bytes MUST round-trip unchanged through Message.Value across Publish->Subscribe in the InMemoryBroker AND through json.Marshal/Unmarshal of the Message struct.
expected_invariants.key_preservation: Optional key bytes (including non-ASCII) MUST round-trip unchanged.
expected_invariants.headers_preservation: Headers map MUST round-trip unchanged across Publish/Subscribe.
expected_invariants.topic_preservation: Topic strings (including non-ASCII Cyrillic/Japanese/Arabic) MUST be deliverable to subscribers.
expected_invariants.ordering: PublishBatch MUST deliver messages to subscribers in the order published for a single topic.
expected_invariants.consumer_group_dispatch: ConsumerGroup MUST route each subscribed topic to its registered handler without cross-talk.
expected_invariants.retry_dlq: RetryPolicy with exhausted budget MUST forward the failing message to the configured DLQ topic with original bytes intact.
expected_invariants.interface_contract: InMemoryBroker MUST satisfy broker.MessageBroker — verified by compile-time blank assignment.
